name: World: Connection — The Librarian of the Glass Library
brief:
WORLD: Glass Library, a collapsing archive of failed worlds and lost memories.
PREMISE: The connector must find the first connector record before the censors bind it shut.
TONE: quiet wonder, archival horror, melancholy mystery, crystalline Y2K fantasy.
PHILOSOPHY: To remember is to change what survived.

ui_copy.signal_body: A collapsing library of records is calling you. Find the first connector's record before the censor binds it shut.

session_intro.title: The Librarian of the Glass Library
session_intro.body: The records of failed worlds sleep within the glass stacks. Before the censor binds the first connector's record shut, you must find it and read it.
rules: To read is to intervene — every time you open a record, the world shifts a little.
When the censorship seal rises, the stacks close.
Gather clues to raise your access.
session_intro.objective: Find the first connector's record and restore it before the seal closes.

main_arcs.title: Act 1: The Broken Catalog Room
main_arcs.summary: The player connects to the Glass Library, meets Io, and confirms the existence of the first connector record.

main_arcs.title: Act 2: The Unreturned Reader
main_arcs.summary: Traveling with Miro, the forgotten reader, you search for the memory of an erased world and the first clue.

main_arcs.title: Act 3: The White Light of the Binding Room
main_arcs.summary: Over the names the censor cut away and the forbidden-book index, you choose between infiltration, negotiation, or restoration.

main_arcs.title: Act 4: The Archive of the First Record
main_arcs.summary: Before the first connector record, you decide whether to read its truth, seal it shut, or carry away only a fragment.

side_arcs.title: Side: The Lost Return Card
side_arcs.description: Find Miro's return card and restore the forgotten reader's name.

side_arcs.title: Side: Decoding the Forbidden Index
side_arcs.description: Decode the fact that the blank line in the censorship index points to a record not yet written.

side_arcs.title: Side: The Drawer of Severed Names
side_arcs.description: Recover the fragments of deleted names from the drawer in the binding room.
